title: 第13章 放走恶人便是作恶第14章 魂城探路欣欣消失
content_zh:
凄惨的叫声回荡在山谷的上空。
刀疤脸捂着断腕，痛苦地在地上翻滚。
脸上因为极致的痛苦和难以置信而扭曲变形。
突如其来的变故让陈欣欣心中一惊，停止了哭泣，怔怔地看着眼前的一幕。
一道熟悉的碧绿色身影，如同鬼魅般，悄无声息地悬浮在刀疤脸的上空。
“球球！不要杀他们！”
陈欣欣挣扎起身，连忙挡在他们之间。
她的小脸上还挂着泪珠，眼神中充满了不忍和祈求。
茅不易看着眼前的少女，心中不解道：
“为什么这些人明明想要伤害她，她却依旧会保护他们。”
茅不易双翅微振，将自己不解以及生气的传达给欣欣。
“球球我知道他们是坏人，但是.......杀了他们，球球你......”
欣欣不知该如何表达自己心中的感受——对掠夺生命的本能抗拒。
“但放走他们，会有更多人会因为他们受到伤害。”
她用力的摇了摇头，泪水滑落。
“我会让他们保证的，我不想你因为我再造杀孽！”
“求你了，放他们走好不好！”
茅不易周身的杀意在欣欣一句又一句的话语中逐渐消散。
他虽然无法理解欣欣那种复杂的仁慈，但他能感觉到欣欣内心的痛苦和不怨。
它缓缓飞到欣欣怀中。

“让他们滚吧！”
欣欣见茅不易松口，连忙转身。
“你们快走吧，但得保证别再干这种勾当了！”
山贼们如同大赦一般，连忙跪在地上痛哭流涕。
他们保证绝对不会再犯了，说完便连滚带爬的朝着远方逃去。
欣欣将脸靠在茅不易碧绿的甲壳之上，语气轻柔。
“谢谢你，球球！”
待吃过灵果后，一人一虫继续赶路。
夜幕降临，月黑风高，杀人的绝佳时机！
茅不易确认欣欣已经睡着之后，便悄悄的溜了出去。
他展开神识覆盖周边，顺着白日里的道路折返了回去。
山谷的某处山洞之中，隐约有着火光闪现。
还夹杂着压抑的呜咽以及男人猥琐的狞笑。
content_en:
The miserable screams echoed over the valley.
Scarface covered his broken wrist and rolled on the ground in pain.
His face was distorted by extreme pain and disbelief.
The sudden change shocked Chen Xinxin, she stopped crying and stared blankly at the scene in front of her.
A familiar green figure, like a ghost, floated silently above Scarface.
"Qiuqiu! Don't kill them!"
Chen Xinxin struggled to get up and quickly stood between them.
There were tears still hanging on her little face, and her eyes were filled with unbearable and pleading.
Mao Buyi looked at the girl in front of him and said in confusion:
"Why do these people obviously want to hurt her, but she still protects them?"
Mao Buyi flapped his wings slightly, conveying his confusion and anger to Xinxin.
"Qiuqiu, I know they are bad people, but...kill them, Qiuqiu, you..."
Xinxin didn't know how to express her feelings - her instinctive resistance to plundering life.
"But if we let them go, more people will be harmed because of them."
She shook her head vigorously, tears falling down.
"I will make them promise, I don't want you to kill again because of me!"
"Please, please let them go!"
The killing intent around Mao Buyi gradually dissipated in Xinxin's words one after another.
Although he couldn't understand Xinxin's complicated kindness, he could feel the pain and lack of resentment in Xinxin's heart.
It slowly flew into Xinxin's arms.
"Let them go!"
Xinxin saw Mao Buyi let go and quickly turned around.
"You should leave quickly, but you must promise not to do this kind of thing again!"
The bandits quickly knelt on the ground and cried bitterly, as if they were being granted amnesty.
They promised that they would never do it again, and after saying that, they rolled and crawled away towards the distance.
Xinxin leaned her face against Mao Buyi's green carapace and spoke softly.
"Thank you, Qiuqiu!"
After eating the spiritual fruit, one person and one insect continued on their way.
Night falls, the moon is dark and the wind is high, it’s the perfect time to kill!
After Mao Buyi confirmed that Xinxin was asleep, he quietly slipped out.
He spread his consciousness to cover the surrounding area and turned back along the road in the daytime.
There was a faint flash of fire in a cave somewhere in the valley.
It was also mixed with suppressed sobs and the man's lewd grin.
